title: Mutually Exclusive Timeout Configuration Ranges
pattern: Defining timeout or limits configuration properties that can be set to logically conflicting ranges, lacking internal assertion checks.
why_bad: Creates invalid execution states. If an operator sets the connection timeout higher than the absolute request limit, requests fail instantly on congested routes, causing opaque, hard-to-trace connection dropouts.
detection: Two related configuration parameters evaluated independently without corresponding range assertions at loading time.
fix: Implement strict range and invariant assertions in the configuration parsing phase, failing early and crashing the server if conflict thresholds are met.
source: Gregg, Brendan - *Systems Performance_ Enterprise and the Cloud* (2013, Pearson Education Limited (US titles)_Prentice Hall).pdf, Chapter 10; Ousterhout, John K - *A Philosophy of Software Design* (2018_2019, Yaknyam Press).pdf, Section 8.2.
